### 💡 Feature Summary
A concise description of the feature or enhancement you would like to see.

### ❓ Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
A clear and concise description of what the problem or limitation is. (e.g. *I always get frustrated when...*)

### 🎯 Proposed Solution
A clear description of what you want to happen and how it should work from a user experience standpoint.

### 🛠️ Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions, features, or workarounds you have considered.

### 📱 Target Form Factor
- [ ] Android Mobile / Phone
- [ ] Android Tablet / Foldable
- [ ] Android TV / Google TV / FireStick

### 📝 Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.
